edges.reason: Constructor assigns the literal token name to state variable name
Constructor assigns the literal token symbol to state variable symbol
Constructor sets decimals to 18
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed initial supply
Initial supply is credited to balances[msg.sender] during minting
msg.sender is the storage key used to record the minted balance
Constructor writes the balances mapping
Constructor consumes msg.sender as the mint recipient
totalSupply reads state variable _totalSupply
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as the subtraction operand
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction
totalSupply performs raw unchecked subtraction with no SafeMath guard
balanceOf reads the balances mapping
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping
balanceOf returns the named local balance
allowance reads the allowed mapping
tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowed mapping
spender parameter is the inner key of the allowed mapping
allowance returns the named local remaining
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender]
msg.sender is the allowance owner key in approve and in transferFrom allowance debiting
spender parameter is the inner key written by approve
tokens parameter is the allowance value written by approve
approve returns the named local success
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping
to parameter is the credited balance key in transfer
tokens parameter changes the balance values in transfer
transfer invokes safeSub on balances[msg.sender]
transfer invokes safeAdd on balances[to]
transfer performs balance arithmetic through the SafeMath helpers
balances mapping values are the operands of the transfer arithmetic
tokens parameter is the amount subtracted and added in transfer
safeSub result is written back to balances[msg.sender] in transfer
safeAdd result is written back to balances[to] in transfer and in transferFrom
transfer returns the named local success
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping
transferFrom reads and writes the allowed mapping
from parameter is the debited balance key in transferFrom
to parameter is the credited balance key in transferFrom
tokens parameter changes balance values in transferFrom
tokens parameter debits the allowance in transferFrom
from parameter is the outer allowance key in transferFrom
transferFrom invokes safeSub on the balance and on the allowance
transferFrom invokes safeAdd on the recipient balance
transferFrom performs balance and allowance arithmetic through SafeMath
balances values are operands of the transferFrom arithmetic
allowed[from][msg.sender] is an operand of the transferFrom arithmetic
safeSub result is written back to allowed[from][msg.sender] in transferFrom
transferFrom returns the named local success
safeAdd first operand feeds the addition
safeAdd second operand feeds the addition
safeAdd stores the sum in the named return c
safeSub first operand feeds the subtraction
safeSub second operand feeds the subtraction and the require check
safeSub stores the difference in the named return c
safeMul first operand feeds the multiplication
safeMul second operand feeds the multiplication
safeMul stores the product in the named return c
safeDiv numerator feeds the division
safeDiv denominator feeds the division and the require check
safeDiv stores the quotient in the named return c

normalization_plan.reason: approve.spender is only used to index allowed inside the approve function
approve.tokens is only used as the allowance value written by approve
transfer.to is only used as the credited balance key inside transfer
transfer.tokens is only used as the arithmetic amount inside transfer
transferFrom.from is only used to index balances and allowed inside transferFrom
transferFrom.to is only used as the credited balance key inside transferFrom
transferFrom.tokens is only used as the arithmetic amount inside transferFrom
balanceOf.tokenOwner is only used to index balances in balanceOf
allowance.tokenOwner is only used as the outer key in allowance
allowance.spender is only used as the inner key in allowance
safeAdd.a is a purely arithmetic operand of the safeAdd helper
safeAdd.b is a purely arithmetic operand of the safeAdd helper
safeSub.a is a purely arithmetic operand of the safeSub helper
safeSub.b is a purely arithmetic operand of the safeSub helper
safeMul.a is a purely arithmetic operand of the safeMul helper
safeMul.b is a purely arithmetic operand of the safeMul helper
safeDiv.a is a purely arithmetic operand of the safeDiv helper
safeDiv.b is a purely arithmetic operand of the safeDiv helper
safeAdd.c is the sole named return of safeAdd and adds no independent semantics
safeSub.c is the sole named return of safeSub and adds no independent semantics
safeMul.c is the sole named return of safeMul and adds no independent semantics
safeDiv.c is the sole named return of safeDiv and adds no independent semantics
balanceOf.balance is the named return mirroring balances[tokenOwner]
allowance.remaining is the named return mirroring allowed[tokenOwner][spender]
